title: Title Maker
story: The market sign painter capitalises every word on a sign.
goal: Read a sentence and print it with each word capitalised.
hints: Split the sentence into words, fix each word, then join them back with spaces.
words = sentence.split() gives a list. " ".join(list) glues it back.

sentence = input()
words = sentence.split()
fixed = []
for w in words:
    fixed.append(w.capitalize())
print(" ".join(fixed))
socratic: How do you break a sentence into words?
Which method fixes the capitals of one word?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Title Maker”?
solution:
sentence = input()
words = sentence.split()
fixed = []
for w in words:
    fixed.append(w.capitalize())
print(" ".join(fixed))

example.title: Worked example: shout every word
example.code:
words = "go team go".split()
print(" ".join(w.upper() for w in words))
example.note: split() cuts text into words; join() glues them back together.
